## The Jolly Roger

A pirate without a flag is just a sailor with bad manners. Luffy drew the Straw Hat Jolly Roger himself, badly.

Join the Pirates and carry a flag of your own.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Join the Pirates](f_pirates.md#q-51e709d11c17a755)

**Tasks**

- Carry a flag

**Rewards**

- Doriki +120, Belly +5,000, Bounty +200,000

## A Price on Your Head

Luffy's first poster said 30,000,000 Belly and he celebrated for a day. The Marines take note of anyone who keeps winning.

Raise your bounty to 1,000,000.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [The Jolly Roger](f_pirates.md#q-55c653664d6d5894)

**Tasks**

- Reach 1,000,000 Bounty

**Rewards**

- Doriki +180, Belly +8,000

## Plunder

Marine captains carry pay chests and orders. Both are worth taking.

Defeat three Marine captains and fifteen Marine grunts.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [A Price on Your Head](f_pirates.md#q-6554f58210f819bd)

**Rewards**

- Doriki +210, Belly +8,500, Bounty +500,000

## Davy Back Fight

Three games, winner takes a crewmate. Foxy cheated at every one of them.

Defeat 2 pirate players in Paradise.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Plunder](f_pirates.md#q-5a4f218185421ac3)

**Tasks**

- Defeat 2 pirate players in Paradise

**Rewards**

- Doriki +360, Belly +15,000, Bounty +1,000,000

## Supernova

Eleven rookies with bounties over a hundred million reached Sabaody in the same week. The Navy called them Supernovas.

Raise your bounty to 25,000,000 and land on the Sabaody Archipelago. A bounty this size also attracts the World Government's Warlord offers.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Davy Back Fight](f_pirates.md#q-18f5eb680ff1d04a)

**Tasks**

- Reach 25,000,000 Bounty
- Land on the Sabaody Archipelago

**Rewards**

- Doriki +420, Belly +24,500, +1 Training Points (your style), Bounty +1,500,000

Luffy had the World Government's flag shot down at Enies Lobby, then went to get his archaeologist back.

## Jailbreak

More than two hundred prisoners walked out of Impel Down behind a rubber man, a clown and a queen of the okama.

Free a prisoner from Impel Down's cells, and defeat twenty-five hostiles in Impel Down.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Declare War on the World](f_pirates.md#q-7a3baa9554dd2f5d)

**Tasks**

- Free a prisoner
- Defeat 25 hostiles in Impel Down

**Rewards**

- Doriki +540, Belly +24,500, +1 Training Points (your style), Bounty +2,000,000

## Heavenly Demon

Doflamingo was born a Celestial Dragon and chose to become a monster at sea instead.

Raise your bounty to 50,000,000. Captains who get this far may earn the Heavenly Demon trait.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Jailbreak](f_pirates.md#q-20db6391c2ba14a8)

**Tasks**

- Reach 50,000,000 Bounty

**Rewards**

- Doriki +540, Belly +42,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +1 Training Points (your style), Bounty +3,000,000

## Territory of an Emperor

Emperors protect their territories, and their territories pay them for it. Fish-Man Island once flew Whitebeard's flag and nobody touched it.

Own three islands at the same time through island conquest. Spend time, build and fight on an island to raise your score; ownership changes at each review.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Heavenly Demon](f_pirates.md#q-12cefa4e827ff00c)

**Tasks**

- Own 3 islands at once (island conquest)

**Rewards**

- Doriki +540, Belly +80,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +1 Training Points (your style), Bounty +3,000,000

<a id="q-50c959030b7d5c5a"></a>

## Emperor of the Sea

Four pirates rule the New World. Nobody gave them the title; the world simply started using it.

Raise your bounty to 100,000,000 and own five islands at once, two of them in the New World. Holy Knights hunt bounties this large.

**Prerequisites (all of)** — [Territory of an Emperor](f_pirates.md#q-1c0c8033f271f6e0)

**Tasks**

- Reach 100,000,000 Bounty
- Own 5 islands at once (island conquest)
- Own 2 islands in the New World at once (island conquest)

**Rewards**

- Doriki +750, Belly +250,000, Haki +5 Busoshoku / +5 Kenbunshoku, +2 Training Points (your style), Golden Box
